# archestra_role (Data Source)

Looks up a role by ID. Accepts both base62 custom-role IDs and predefined role names (`admin`, `member`, `owner`, …).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a role by ID — accepts both base62 custom-role IDs and
# the literal name of a predefined role (`admin`, `member`, …).

data "archestra_role" "predefined_admin" {
  id = "admin"
}

output "admin_permissions" {
  value = data.archestra_role.predefined_admin.permission
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Role identifier — base62 for custom roles or the literal name for predefined roles.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `description` (String) Free-form description.
- `name` (String) Human-readable role name.
- `permission` (Map of List of String) Permission grants keyed by resource name; values are lists of action verbs.
- `predefined` (Boolean) True for backend-managed roles.
- `role` (String) Immutable role slug.
- `updated_at` (String) Last-update timestamp (RFC 3339), or null if never updated.
